# A comment after an opening brace or bracket is kept.
celfmt -i map.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_map.txt

celfmt -i want_map.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_map.txt

celfmt -i list.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_list.txt

celfmt -i want_list.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_list.txt

# The formatter puts a map that is a macro argument on its own line, so the
# comment follows the preceding comma.
celfmt -i arg.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_arg.txt

celfmt -i want_arg.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_arg.txt

-- map.cel --
{ // c1
	"a": state.a, // c2
	"b": state.b, // c3
}
-- want_map.txt --
{ // c1
	"a": state.a, // c2
	"b": state.b, // c3
}
-- list.cel --
[ // c4
	state.a, // c5
	state.b // c6
]
-- want_list.txt --
[ // c4
	state.a, // c5
	state.b, // c6
]
-- arg.cel --
state.x.as(y, { // c7
	"a": y,
})
-- want_arg.txt --
state.x.as(y, // c7
	{
		"a": y,
	}
)
